name: Rocket Bites - 200mg Edible Gummies - Mighty Melon
description:
Big flavor in a small bite. Rocket Bites Mighty Melon gummies deliver sweet, juicy melon taste — refreshing, smooth, and satisfying in every piece.

Made with an indica profile for a relaxed, mellow feel, these are a great pick for evenings and winding down. Each pack contains 10 gummies at 20mg each — 200mg total — so it's easy to dial in exactly the dose you want.

10 gummies × 20mg — 200mg per pack
Sweet Mighty Melon flavor — juicy, refreshing melon
Indica — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Easy to portion — consistent dosing in every piece

Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.
